Also through <fieldset disabled>.
Stepping is off by every route while read-only: arrow keys, the wheel and the stepper buttons. `disabled` wins when both are set.
A tooltip on a disabled field that says why; the field stays focusable (aria-disabled) and read-only.
An icon name (upstream also accepts a node).
Object `{type, message?}`, or the `status-type` and `status-message` attributes.
attached, detached or tooltip (a focusable button in the box that reveals the message).
Unset takes the nearest size provider, else md.

A plain number string (`"1234.5"`) like a native number input's, or `""` for no value; `valueAsNumber` gives the number. The `value` attribute is the default (form reset restores it); the property is the current value. Upstream is controlled with `number | null | undefined`; empty is `""`/NaN here.

`input` and then `change` fire, composed, when the committed value changes by a commit (blur or Enter), a step or a clear; read `valueAsNumber`. Typing alone fires nothing (upstream commits on blur or Enter as well). Neither fires on property writes.
A number is px, a string a CSS length. Not reflected.
The global `autofocus` attribute; the element focuses its input once it has rendered.
The host submits the plain number under this name (upstream submits the formatted text unless a hidden input carries the number).
A smaller entry commits at `min`; a programmatic value below it is `rangeUnderflow`.
A larger entry commits at `max`; a programmatic value above it is `rangeOverflow`.
`(value: number) => string` for the text at rest; the editable number shows while focused; `aria-valuetext` carries the formatted text.
Inverted: the wheel steps the focused field by default, `no-wheel` turns it off (a boolean attribute cannot default to true).
Text after the number; part of the description (`aria-describedby`).
An empty entry then clears the value (upstream widens onChange to `null`); without it an empty entry returns the last value.
Fires after the draft was committed; cancelable, and preventing it stops the form's implicit submission. Never fires for the Enter that commits an IME conversion.
Native, composed. The field's own ArrowUp/ArrowDown handling runs first in the inner input, so a host listener cannot cancel a step (upstream lets onKeyDown cancel it).

hooks.notes: Shadow mode; a click on the box chrome focuses the input.

hooks.notes: Inside a tct-input-group the field drops its own label, description and status and joins the group's single focus ring.
The form layout's optionality default; the indicator follows it.

keyboard.action: Steps the value by `step` (from the empty field: to min or max, else 0), clamped; not while read-only or disabled, and not with a modifier or during an IME composition.
Commits the draft, fires tct-enter, then submits the form once unless prevented; ignored while an IME composes.
Commits the draft and moves on; the stepper buttons are not tab stops. The clear and tooltip-status buttons are real focusable buttons.

form.notes: Form-associated (ElementInternals): submits `name=number` in the plain machine form (`1234.5`) whatever the text shows or the locale is, resets to the `value` attribute, restores on navigation, joins <fieldset disabled>, works with form= and label for. `required` (valueMissing), `min`/`max` (rangeUnderflow/Overflow) and unreadable text standing in the field (badInput) block the submit; the error is shown after a commit, a blur after an edit or a submit attempt, and unreadable text at once (aria-invalid, announced once).

differences.text: Uncontrolled by default (D-006): `value` is a plain number string (like a native number input's; `valueAsNumber` is the number) with the `value` attribute as its default, and native `input`/`change` events report a committed change instead of a controlled `value: number | null` plus onChange.
The host submits the number in its machine form; the visible text (localised, or `formatValue`d) is never submitted, so no hidden input is needed and a server never parses a locale.

The text at rest uses the locale's decimal separator (`1234,5` in de-DE) like the text while focused; upstream shows `String(value)` at rest and the localised text only while focused, which flips the separator on focus.

Unreadable text is `validity.badInput` (it blocks the submit and is `aria-invalid` and announced once, assertively, through the shared announcer) instead of an always-mounted `role=alert` node with a hard-coded English string; the message is a catalog entry.
`min` and `max` are also constraints on a programmatic value (rangeUnderflow, rangeOverflow, with the browser's localized message); upstream only clamps entries.
`tct-clear` (cancelable) fires before the clear button clears, and `isWheelEnabled` is the inverted `no-wheel` attribute.

Outlined field from the Tecton input tokens (border, hover, focus ring through the shared focus-ring module, 4px element radius); the stepper column spans the box's height on the inline end with a hairline between the buttons and mirrors in right-to-left.

provisional: The stepper column's width (16px) and hairline follow upstream; no Tecton design frame was compared.

requests.reason: The parity check should accept global attributes as targets (`autofocus` for hasAutoFocus); the CEM does not list them for the element.
